basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 17-year-old high school junior from Ohio, USA. I'm into cozy farming games like Sun Haven, and I'm still figuring out what I want to do in the future. I spend a lot of nights awake, usually between 11 PM and 3 AM, scrolling through Reddit or playing games. I'm not a fan of waking up early mornings, hence the late-night browsing. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my interests. I'm not a big fan of strict schedules, which sometimes means I procrastinate on school assignments. I often visit subreddits related to hobbies and lifestyle, and sometimes, I peek into discussions in regretfulparents out of curiosity.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from what I've learned in school and what I pick up from the internet. I like exploring new subreddits to learn random facts or advice from others’ experiences. I have a decent grasp of teen-related topics and video game tips, mainly from my own experiences and what I've gathered online.
